title: Code Locations for Statement Bodies
statement: Let $F$ be a natural number of local variables per frame, let $bs$ be a finite list of statements, and let $pos$ be a natural-number position. Suppose the concatenation, starting at $pos$, of the compiled code for each statement in $bs$ followed by its epilogue is a prefix of the instruction sequence beginning at $pos$. For every index $p$ and statement $b$ occurring at index $p$ in $bs$, there is an entry position $e$ at index $p$ in the sequence of body entry positions, such that the compiled code for $b$ followed by its epilogue is a prefix of the instruction sequence beginning at $e$, and $e$ plus the size of $b$ (for frame size $F$) plus $5$ is at most the end position of the bodies.
